name: AI automation 1: Scripts
blurb: Make AI do your boring tasks: when automating pays off, prompt templates, one-call scripts, batches of files, pipelines, routers, folder watchers, never doing work twice, approval gates, dry runs and cost budgets. 12 short lessons, 15 to 40 minutes each. No coding experience needed: every lesson shows the Python it uses with a worked example first. The AI crash course first helps. Part 2 does the same with n8n.
